name: electrobun-plugin
description: Complete Electrobun skill: scaffold, debug, reason about, AND drive running Electrobun apps via embedded MCP server. Skill: main SKILL.md + 9 sub-skills (scaffold, views, ipc-rpc, build-dist, updater, webgpu, system-integration, architecture, zig-main). MCP: 16 tools across CDP (webview) + custom bridge (bun process / RPC / FFI / updater / native logs). Source-grounded against upstream blackboardsh/electrobun. Companion npm pkg `electrobun-devtools` powers the bridge.

cdpPort.title: CDP port
cdpPort.description: Chrome DevTools Protocol port. Must match `chromiumFlags['remote-debugging-port']` in your electrobun.config.ts.

devtoolsPort.title: Devtools bridge port
devtoolsPort.description: Local port the `electrobun-devtools` server listens on. Must match what `devtools.start({ port })` is called with.

allowEval.title: Allow bun_eval
allowEval.description: Allow Claude to evaluate arbitrary code in the bun main process via the `electrobun_bun_eval` tool. OFF by default — opt in deliberately. High blast radius; only enable for trusted sessions.
